node: Optical interconnect, lasers, silicon photonics, and compound-semiconductor epitaxy tools
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the optical-interconnect bottleneck with one reference laser/transceiver name and three less-obvious second-order names. The underfollowed lane emphasizes tool capacity, silicon-photonics foundry capacity, and signal-integrity chips rather than only visible optical-module assemblers. Key chokepoint hypotheses to test in later layers: whether 1.6T/3.2T AI datacenter optics create scarcity in qualified InP/GaAs epitaxy tools, silicon-photonics foundry capacity, and high-speed analog/TIA components, or whether the benefit is mainly broad volume growth without durable pricing power.
